summary: Round 10 (Admin + Customer Bug Sweep — 6 targeted fixes) verified. Backend: created /app/backend/tests/test_final_qa_r10.py with 17 pytest cases — all pass. Coverage: (1) POST /jobs/{id}/accept now returns ok=true, atomic-updates job to status='accepted' with assigned_driver_name populated, /jobs/mine still returns the job so the customer can pay the deposit; push_notification stores {title:'Driver accepted your job', data:{job_id, kind:'job_accepted'}}; email_log persists a customer_driver_accepted row (status='skipped' in preview — expected, RESEND_API_KEY unset). (2) GET /admin/jobs/{id} returns the full envelope {job, customer, driver, bids, booking} and derives recommended_vehicle on the fly for historic jobs, 404 on unknown. (3) GET /admin/users supports ?role=customer|driver filter; GET /admin/users/{id} returns {user, recent_jobs, recent_bookings} with password_hash stripped; 404 on unknown. (4) POST /admin/contact-messages/{id}/reply sends via services/email.send_admin_contact_reply — email_log row has sender='admin@cargoone.co.uk' AND reply_to='admin@cargoone.co.uk'; contact_messages row is stamped with replied_at + replied_by_name + last_reply_status; rejects <5 char body with 400; 404 on unknown; blocks non-admins. Frontend Playwright: (a) Admin All Jobs — rows are clickable buttons data-testid='admin-job-open-<id>'; modal 'admin-job-modal' opens and renders job breakdown incl. suitable-vehicle chip, Customer card, and 'No booking exists yet' when there isn't one. (b) Admin All Users — tab strip renders with keys `all/customer/driver/admin` (NOTE: spec text said plural but implementation uses singular keys; both interpretations OK since the tabs work — minor spec vs code deviation flagged below). Switching tab filters the list and role badges 'admin-user-role-driver'/-customer render correctly; clicking a row opens 'admin-user-modal' with USER / STATUS / JOBS / BOOKINGS panels. (c) Admin Dispatch Monitor Refresh — with request throttled to 1.2s, the Refresh button correctly (i) disables, (ii) swaps its label to 'Refreshing…', and (iii) spins the RefreshCw icon (animate-spin present) during the fetch — visually confirmed via screenshot. 5s poll still ticks. (d) Admin Queues Reply — 'contact-reply-<id>' opens the modal with subject prefilled 'Re: <original>'; sending body >=5 chars returns success, and the corresponding row renders the 'contact-replied-<id>' pill. (e) Notification deep-link — Customer Dashboard Bell button (data-testid='notifications-button') now hrefs to /customer/messages?tab=notifications; Messages opens on the Updates tab; selecting a 'Driver accepted your job' notification renders the 'notification-open-link' CTA hrefed to /customer/job/<id> (screenshot confirms 'Open job' button rendered). No P0/P1 regressions found.

issues: Tab data-testids use SINGULAR keys (admin-users-tab-customer / -driver / -admin) whereas the spec text described 'Customers / Drivers / Admins' (plural). Not a functional bug — filter + list update correctly — but worth aligning the spec or the testid to avoid future automation drift.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py POST /jobs/{id}/accept still swallows email-send failures via broad except+logger.exception — good — but the customer notification/email is only sent for FIXED-PRICE bidding accept (this endpoint). ASAP /claim already emails the driver via driver_booking_accepted; if the product ever adds ASAP customer-side deposit collection, the customer_driver_accepted email helper needs wiring into that path too.

email_log entry (services/email.py::_send_and_log) still does NOT persist the rendered HTML/text body — flagged in r9 too. Ops cannot audit exact wording of a delivered admin_contact_reply after the fact; consider adding a `text_snippet` (first 500 chars).
server.py has grown to 5610 lines (was 5482 at r9, 5442 at r7). New admin drilldown endpoints keep adding to the monolith. Consider splitting the /admin routes into a dedicated router module.

Admin Users.jsx ROLE_TABS uses singular keys internally while the spec/UI label is plural — minor but the review_request spec explicitly names the testids 'admin-users-tab-{key}' with {key} left as a placeholder, so this is a documentation ambiguity, not a defect.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (5/5 UI checkpoints verified via Playwright: admin-jobs modal, admin-users tabs+drilldown+badges, dispatch refresh spinner, queues reply modal end-to-end incl. replied pill, customer notification deep-link with Open-job CTA)

seed_data_creation: Pytest self-seeds contact_messages rows (id prefix cm-qar10-*), fixed-price jobs (title QAR10-FP-*), and TEST_qar10_* prefixed users. No cleanup performed intentionally so the QA report leaves an audit trail. All test data is safely prefixed and can be bulk-deleted by regex if desired.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Round 10 6-bug sweep is GREEN end-to-end. When retesting the customer accept-flow, note that /jobs/mine already returned the accepted job even before this round — the actual UI bug lived only in Bookings.jsx openJobs filter (posted-only → posted+accepted). Bookings.jsx now dedupes against real bookings by job_id so paying the deposit will still swap the row into the 'bookings' pane. Admin Users tab keys are SINGULAR (all/customer/driver/admin) — if the spec/task mentions plural, use singular in Playwright selectors. Dispatch refresh spinner is only visible while the /admin/dispatch/active request is inflight (<250ms on preview), so throttle via page.route to reliably observe the animate-spin/disabled/label-swap trio. RESEND_API_KEY is intentionally unset — every email_log row will be status='skipped' with a plausible sender ('admin@cargoone.co.uk' for admin_contact_reply, 'noreply@…' for customer_driver_accepted) — not a defect.
rca of the issue: N/A — no new defects surfaced in Round 10 scope. All 6 reported bugs are demonstrably fixed at both backend and frontend layers.
